issues.description: Constructor signature mismatch for class `Bookstore`: the problem statement specifies an initializer with the signature `init(books: [Book])` (problem_statement.md line 11). The solution implementation defines an initializer with an extra parameter: `init(books: [Book], valid: Bool)` (Sources/BookstoreLib/Bookstore.swift line 14). The solution's Client also calls `Bookstore(books: books)` (Sources/BookstoreLib/Client.swift line 57). This inconsistency between the required API and the implemented constructor will cause compilation failure for code that invokes `Bookstore(books: ...)` and will confuse students about which initializer they must implement.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the solution's `Bookstore` initializer match the problem specification `init(books: [Book])` by removing the extra `valid: Bool` parameter or by adding a second initializer `init(books: [Book])` that delegates to the existing implementation. After that, update any call sites as needed. Alternatively, if the extra parameter is intentional, update the problem statement and all example/client code to require and use `init(books: [Book], valid: Bool)` so all artifacts are consistent.
